question: Aditya appeared in a competitive exam in which the final grades are determined by three different exams of 100 marks having weights 20%, 35% and 45%, respectively. If Aditya scored 80, 70 and 60 marks in these exams, respectively, then what is the weighted average score of Aditya?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Simplify the ratio of weights: 20% : 35% : 45% = 4 : 7 : 9.

Total ratio parts = 4 + 7 + 9 = 20.

Let the assumed average be 70.

Net deviation = [4 × (80 − 70) + 7 × (70 − 70) + 9 × (60 − 70)] ÷ 20

Net deviation = (40 + 0 − 90) ÷ 20 = −50 ÷ 20 = −2.5

**∴ The correct answer is 67.5 marks.**
